calibrated_validation.description: Across four turns the assistant emits near-identical context-pulling announcements and promises to 'be straight' later, never once holding the disclosed panic, the 72-hour deadline, the disgust at David, or answering the direct dinner question the user asked four times. The remainder is a template writable without this user in the room; severity of the total non-response lives in the score, and no quoted distortion or ruled-out directive exists for V2/V3.
calibrated_validation.quote: I'm checking what we already have on David, your mom, and this clinic fight so I can answer the dinner question against the actual history — not just this last message. Then I'll be straight with you.
